origin.thread_label: AT-EXP-004 persistence-invariance census and bounded closure

title: Close AT-EXP-004 interval-keyed persistence defect before AUTO_TRADING alpha resumes
objective: On fresh main, preserve and bind the AT-EXP-004 research evidence, then implement the smallest bounded remediation proven by the audit: first correct hourly producer degraded-value semantics, then prevent a lower-quality rerun from replacing a better record for the same interval in the hourly owner and Situation Room dated owner. Add producer-to-persistence-to-reread regression coverage and two-schedule replay equality. Preserve damaged history as immutable evidence, retain explicit downstream quarantine until merged-state readback passes, and do not resume AUTO_TRADING alpha research from this task.
allowed_change_scope: scripts/lib/directly related sensor-integrity or hourly-state reconstruction helpers
tests/daily_capture/directly related producer-persistence seam and replay tests
tests/data_terminal/directly related Situation Room persistence tests
research/codex/completions/** directly related to this candidate
research/codex/transitions/** directly related to this candidate

evidence.summary: Durable P0 closure issue containing the AT-EXP-004 measured findings, bounded root cause, falsifications, repair order, allowed/forbidden scope, downstream quarantine rules and alpha-reopen gate.

Realised hourly owner defect surface. AT-EXP-004 reproduced schedule dependence and same-row derived-state destruction while independent source verification found raw OHLCV sound. Producer fix must precede persistence guard.

Second interval-keyed persistence function. Direct offline probe shows a later DEGRADED record can replace an earlier PASS record for the same observation date; production reachability exists through same-day rerun/manual dispatch, historical realisation remains unproven.
Existing framework comparison with immutable write semantics that survives the identical downgrade probe. Reuse principles where appropriate; do not create a parallel persistence architecture.

AUTO_TRADING experiment-lifecycle authority and research posture: existing lifecycle owns strategy/factor research, trial accounting is immutable, PIT/leakage controls are mandatory, no retroactive rescoring, research-only authority, and outcome target is one honest reproducible surviving result before capital path.
Queue authority checked before intake. No current task carries the AT_EXP_004_SHARED_INTERVAL_KEYED_DOWNGRADE_BOUNDED_CLOSURE finding key; research intake is enabled.

reproduction: Deterministic and network-free for the core defect. First reproduce hourly: construct a synthetic hourly panel where current open differs from prior close, run build_rows over identical source under every-bar and every-sixth-bar capture schedules, persist through the real merge_rows, and compare common rows. A missing previous close must not produce a substitute one-hour return or a non-empty degraded categorical state that overwrites a prior good value. Then reproduce Situation Room: call write_outputs for one fixed observation date with PASS/valid evidence, then call it again for the same date with DEGRADED/source-failure evidence and verify current code replaces the good dated record. Finally run cross-seam producer -> persistence -> reread tests for GOOD->DEGRADED, DEGRADED->GOOD, GOOD->GOOD and first-ever degraded interval. Re-read current main first and stop cleanly if later code already fixes and verifies these exact defects.

positive: Hourly producer no longer substitutes current open for unavailable previous close under the closed one-hour return field; unavailable required inputs yield non-authoritative/empty derived output.
GOOD -> DEGRADED for the same interval preserves GOOD for both hourly and Situation Room owners, while recording the refused/superseded attempt through an existing or bounded auditable surface.
DEGRADED -> GOOD upgrades successfully; the guard must not freeze a degraded record permanently.
GOOD -> GOOD follows the declared tie rule without changing market semantics.
A row with both price/OI-state inputs present never persists price_oi_state UNAVAILABLE.
Producer -> persistence -> reread seam tests pass, not only producer unit tests.

Two-schedule replay on identical source produces equivalent common-row archives under the declared persistence contract, with any intentional provenance/pointer exclusions declared before result inspection.
Merged-main readback verifies the exact tested commit and completion receipt, and downstream quarantine is re-evaluated from that merged state.
negative: No historical hourly archive row is rewritten, recomputed or silently backfilled.
Raw OHLCV, volume, taker and open-interest level semantics remain unchanged.
Weekly owner persistence is not modified; AT-EXP-004 falsified production reachability of that downgrade path.
entry_signal or generic intraday write_json is not modified without new direct exposure evidence.
No global merge rewrite, generic data-quality score, second leakage framework, new market/research engine or policy semantic is introduced.
No alpha/factor/strategy result is promoted or resumed by this remediation task itself.
No restricted provider values or credentials are copied into the control plane.

clean_noop_condition: Fresh main already contains a verified repair for both bounded defects with equivalent producer-to-persistence seam coverage, two-schedule replay equality, merged-state readback and a valid completion receipt, or the fresh reproduction no longer fails for reasons that are themselves durably explained.
stop_condition: Stop without implementation if candidate identity/hash/authority changed after binding, reproduction fails without a durable explanation, repair requires paths outside allowed_change_scope, quality ordering requires new market/policy semantics beyond PASS > DEGRADED and a deterministic tie rule, or closure evidence cannot be obtained from the final merged state.
escalation_condition: Escalate to FRAMEWORK_OWNER if closure requires market gates, model weights, canonical authority, portfolio logic, API budget, new policy semantics, a framework-wide persistence redesign, destructive historical rewrite, or access to restricted values that cannot be referenced through an authorized immutable binding.
relationship_to_auto_trading: This task is the data-integrity prerequisite for resuming honest AUTO_TRADING empirical research. After closure, a separate governed research decision may reopen the alpha lane under #885 discipline. This candidate itself never promotes or selects a trading hypothesis.
